compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

S1 [rebar:1934-63dd-4be9-4c48] lets a ticket explicitly assert
`file_impact_scope: none`. The preceding implementation, merged on `main` as
commit `6ec1ad21be8e4d359809a430e61607490a90af29`, gives that assertion real
leverage: an authenticated `file-scope: none` attestation is not invalidated by
unrelated HEAD movement. The existing S1 dependency is closed; the merged
implementation is part of this story's base revision.

The assertion therefore needs a correctness check; otherwise a false declaration
could silence drift protection. The check belongs in plan review, where the
ticket plan, acceptance criteria, persisted scope, and
`no_file_impact_reason` are available. It must be narrow: it runs only when the
persisted scope is exactly `none`; `paths`, `undeclared`, missing, `None`, and
unknown values must not incur an LLM call or finding.

## Approach

Add one advisory LLM criterion, `no-file-impact`, whose sole judgment is whether
a ticket that declares no repository-file impact actually describes work that
requires changing a repository file.

This extends the existing `applies_at` routing mechanism rather than adding a
bespoke orchestration path: `require_parent_id` provides the structural
precedent, deterministic routing isolates cost, and the existing advisory Pass-1
framework already owns LLM execution and fail-open behavior.

### Deterministic applicability

Follow the existing `require_parent_id` routing-axis pattern:

- Add `applies_at.require_file_impact_scope: ["none"]` to the packaged routing
  entry for `no-file-impact`.
- Extend the shared routing validator in
  `src/rebar/llm/criteria/overlay.py` to accept a non-empty list of non-empty
  strings for the new key.
- Extend `registry.applies(...)` with a `file_impact_scope` keyword. When the
  routing entry declares required scopes, return false unless the supplied value
  is a string and is a member of that list. Missing/`None`/unknown values
  therefore fail closed by not selecting this criterion.
- Pass `ctx.state.get("file_impact_scope")` at the single orchestrator call site.

Existing criteria omit the key and retain their current behavior.

### Criterion judgment and prompt discovery

Create `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_no_file_impact.md` with
`category: plan-review-criterion`, `exec: 1-TURN`, facet `scope-intent`,
advisory posture, and a 0.95 block threshold. Plan-review criterion prompts are
auto-discovered from their front matter by the packaged prompt scan; do not edit
the generated `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json`, which only indexes
`category: review` prompts.

The prompt contains a co-located `CHECKLIST SUB-ANSWERS (criterion-local)`
contract defining:

- `assertion_plausible: yes|no|insufficient`
- `reason_grounded: yes|no|insufficient`
- `repo_file_change_named: yes|no`

Its decision rules use every field:

- Set `assertion_plausible: no` when `repo_file_change_named: yes` or when a
  required deliverable otherwise entails a repository edit. Return an advisory
  contradiction finding citing that deliverable and coach declaring its paths.
- Set `assertion_plausible: yes` only when `reason_grounded: yes` and
  `repo_file_change_named: no`, with every deliverable outside the repository.
  Return PASS with no finding.
- Set `assertion_plausible: insufficient` when `reason_grounded` is `no`
  or `insufficient`, `repo_file_change_named: no`, and the plan is too vague to
  establish either outcome. Return non-blocking coaching that asks the author to
  name each deliverable and explain why none requires a repository-file edit.

Reading or analysing repository code without editing it remains compatible with
`none`. A docs-only change is not compatible because documentation is still a
repository file.

### Declared-reason data flow

Read `ctx.state.get("no_file_impact_reason", "")` in the orchestrator and carry
it into Pass 1. The current `pass1.py` seam is an inline G5-only branch, not a
generic per-criterion dispatcher. Replace the single `extra` assignment with
compositional `extra_parts`: append `decomp_context` when the chunk contains G5,
append the declared-reason block when it contains `no-file-impact`, then pass
`"\n\n".join(extra_parts)` to `pass1_chunk`. A chunk containing both criteria
must receive both blocks in stable order. The declared-reason block is:

```text
## Declared no-file-impact context
{"declared_reason":"<JSON-escaped persisted value>"}
```

Serialize the object with deterministic JSON (`sort_keys=True`, compact
separators, UTF-8 preserved) so quotes, newlines, and Unicode in a persisted
reason cannot change the prompt structure. A missing reason serializes as
`{"declared_reason":""}` rather than omitting the field. The criterion prompt
references this field alongside plan text. Do not add a dedicated `PlanContext`
attribute.

### Registration and generated documentation

- Add `no-file-impact` to `CANONICAL_LLM`.
- Add its packaged routing entry, including
  `require_file_impact_scope: ["none"]`.
- Regenerate `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` with the repository generator;
  do not hand-edit the generated section.

## Test Design

Tests assert observable behavior and public contracts, never grep source text or
depend on private implementation shape.

- Applicability contract: invoke the real criterion-selection path with
  persisted scopes `none`, `paths`, `undeclared`, missing/`None`, and an unknown
  future value. Assert `no-file-impact` is selected only for `none`; also assert
  existing criteria select identically across those inputs.
- Prompt-input contract: render the real Pass-1 request for `none` tickets and
  assert parsed structured context preserves (1) a non-empty reason containing
  quotes/newlines/Unicode and (2) a missing reason as the explicit empty string.
  Also render a chunk containing both G5 and `no-file-impact` and assert both
  public context blocks reach the LLM request in stable order. This verifies the
  LLM-boundary contract, not source text.
- Offline rubric behavior: exercise the criterion through the existing offline
  judge fixture with four cases: (1) an external operator action passes; (2) a
  plan requiring a new CLI flag produces advisory contradiction; (3) a
  docs-only plan produces advisory contradiction directing the author to
  declare documentation paths; and (4) a vague plan with an empty or
  ungrounded reason produces non-blocking `insufficient` coaching to strengthen
  `no_file_impact_reason`.
- Public explain contract: invoke `rebar explain no-file-impact` and assert a
  successful exit plus the criterion's semantic identity and applicability in
  output.
- Advisory gate contract: feed each contradiction/coaching outcome through the
  real verdict aggregation path and assert the ticket remains claimable.
- Generated-artifact contract: run the criteria-guide generator twice and assert
  the tracked guide is byte-identical after each run.

The held-out oracle includes legacy/missing scope, empty and escaped reasons,
insufficient coaching, and advisory aggregation. A defect-seeded mutation of the
routing predicate must make the held-out applicability test fail. Tests must
remain green under behavior-preserving rename or extraction.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_no_file_impact.md` — criterion rubric and
  criterion-local sub-answer schema.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json` — packaged routing entry.
- `src/rebar/llm/criteria/overlay.py` — shared routing-key validation.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py` — canonical membership and
  applicability predicate.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/orchestrator.py` — persisted scope/reason input.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py` — structured declared-reason context.
- `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` — generated criterion documentation.
- Focused tests in the existing plan-review, routing, prompt, CLI, and gate test
  modules selected after the required coverage inventory.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Persisted scope `none` routes `no-file-impact` into the Pass-1 finder set.
- [ ] Persisted scope `paths` does not route `no-file-impact`.
- [ ] Persisted scope `undeclared` does not route `no-file-impact`.
- [ ] Missing, `None`, or unknown persisted scope does not route
  `no-file-impact`.
- [ ] External-only deliverables produce PASS with no finding.
- [ ] A required source, configuration, or test-file change produces an advisory
  contradiction finding.
- [ ] A required documentation change produces an advisory contradiction
  finding directing the author to declare documentation paths.
- [ ] Insufficient evidence produces non-blocking coaching to strengthen
  `no_file_impact_reason`.
- [ ] The exact persisted reason round-trips through deterministic structured
  context in the production Pass-1 request.
- [ ] A missing reason reaches the production Pass-1 request as an explicit
  empty string.
- [ ] `no-file-impact` is present in the canonical criterion registry.
- [ ] The packaged routing entry passes shared validation.
- [ ] `rebar explain no-file-impact` succeeds with the generated criterion
  documentation.
- [ ] A fresh second criteria-guide regeneration produces no byte changes.
- [ ] A contradiction finding alone does not block claim.
- [ ] An insufficient coaching finding alone does not block claim.
- [ ] Reintroducing the prior always-selected routing behavior makes at least
  one held-out applicability test fail, and restoring the implementation makes
  that test pass.
- [ ] `make lint` passes.
- [ ] `make typecheck` passes.
- [ ] The full test suite passes.

compose declared-reason context at LLM boundary
happy, edge, boundary, LLM-request, CLI, eval, and guide-generation contracts
pin the new criterion public threshold and advisory posture contract
